notes: Homonym: shares consonants אזן with H238 ("give ear; hearken"), a separate, unrelated Strong's entry already in this dataset (Strong's own etymology note even calls the two "rather identical... through the idea of scales as if two ears" -- a shared etymological origin, not the same attested word; the corpus tags this occurrence to 239 specifically). Per the root-key superscript convention (lower Strong's number gets ¹), H238 has been retroactively relabeled אזן¹ in this same batch (including its DEFAULT_STEM_OVERRIDE entry, updated to "אזן¹": "hiphil" in both UI templates) and this root is אזן².
